description: Upload a local file or URL to DocuPipe and wait for it to be read (OCR and parsing). Returns the document_id used by every other tool. Credits: 1/page for PDF, image, Word and HTML; CSV, Excel, JSON, text and XML upload free.

dataset.description: Optional dataset name to group documents.

file_path.description: Local file, relative to the working directory.

metadata.description: Optional metadata stored with the document.

url.description: Public URL of the file, instead of file_path.

wait.description: Wait for parsing to finish (default true).

name: upload_document
title: Upload a document
